description: Use the Salesforce Reports REST API under /services/data/v{version}/analytics on the registered org. Operations: list (GET /analytics/reports; the vendor's recently viewed reports), create (POST /analytics/reports; body reportMetadata), clone (POST /analytics/reports with query cloneId; body reportMetadata with the new name), describe (GET /analytics/reports/{report_id}/describe), run (GET /analytics/reports/{report_id}; query includeDetails), run_filtered (POST /analytics/reports/{report_id}; body reportMetadata with filters, reportBooleanFilter or groupings; query includeDetails), run_async (POST /analytics/reports/{report_id}/instances; optional body reportMetadata; query includeDetails), instances (GET /analytics/reports/{report_id}/instances), instance_results (GET /analytics/reports/{report_id}/instances/{instance_id}), instance_delete (DELETE the same instance path; the vendor deletes an instance whose status is Success or Error), query (POST /analytics/reports/query; body reportMetadata, runs without saving), update (PATCH /analytics/reports/{report_id}; body reportMetadata), delete (DELETE /analytics/reports/{report_id}), report_types (GET /analytics/reportTypes) and describe_report_type (GET /analytics/reportTypes/{report_type}). Salesforce permissions alone decide each operation, including saves and deletes. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Work with Salesforce reports: list recent reports, describe a report's metadata, run it now with or without detail rows or with ad hoc filters, start an asynchronous run and read its instance results, clone, create, save changes, delete, and list or describe report types. Use for CRM analytics and report maintenance; org permissions decide.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: family, operation, method, status (HTTP), selected headers, body (report list entries with id, name and url; describe with reportMetadata, reportExtendedMetadata and reportTypeMetadata; a run with factMap, groupingsDown, groupingsAcross, allData and hasDetailRows; an instance with id, status Running, Success or Error and requestDate; report types by category), correlation_id, error_code for a 4xx/5xx or unknown status, and pagination.report_all_data false when the run returned only the vendor's first detail rows.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A run's factMap keys are grouping positions (T!T is the grand total); relay aggregates with their labels. report_all_data false means more detail rows exist than one run returns: narrow with run_filtered or export the rows by SOQL or Bulk. Create, clone, update and delete change the org; queued means only that the job was accepted.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Call the Salesforce Reports REST API with the registered user's permissions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params is raised before any vendor call when the operation, report_id, instance_id or cloneId (15- or 18-character ids), report_type (a report type API name), a documented query parameter (includeDetails boolean, cloneId) or a required body member (reportMetadata) does not match the vendor shape. Vendor HTTP errors are completion data with error_code: sf.bad_request (400, for example an invalid filter), sf.session_expired or sf.auth_failed (401), sf.permission_denied (403), sf.not_found (404, including an instance that is already deleted), sf.api_error otherwise.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the status and the vendor message before retrying. A permission error means the registered user lacks Run Reports, Create and Customize Reports or access to the report's folder; grant it in Salesforce. For an asynchronous run, poll instance_results until status is Success or Error rather than re-running.
